name: Assoulsect
ability: Hive Mind (its own: a Bug-type foe's moves never harm it and strike the foe's side instead) / Effect Spore (hidden)
look: a violet fog-cloud of fallen bug souls on two thin black legs, with bug heads sunk in it and blades, horns, lances and a wing bristling out, overgrown by glowing cordyceps fungus stalks
entry: When thousands of Bug Pokémon perished, a fungus took root in what was left of them and wove their souls into one mind. Their old heads and blades still twitch in its fog; any Bug Pokémon that challenges it is pulled into the hive and turns on its own allies.
how: Wild: very rare at night in dark forests, jungles, swamps and mushroom fields, and in lush caves and the deep dark.
